rationale: Dedicated PrivatBank procurement portal — standalone, continuously producing tender/award signals for the largest UA bank.
State bank's own procurement page with annual plan PDFs — forward-looking ATM/POS/card purchases, distinct recurring feed.
Single buyer profile on the uub.com.ua aggregator (50 siblings); monitor the aggregator, not this page.
Authorised Prozorro broker with readable tender pages — standalone redundant index for terminal/banking-service tenders.
Second authorised broker with EDRPOU search — useful redundancy path when the official portal is unavailable.
Registry+tender join platform that resolves winning suppliers into competitor profiles; free tier public, deeper views may need access later.
Treasury payment/contract disclosures reveal actual paid value to banking-tech vendors; fetch failure is soft, re-check liveness.
Umbrella hub pointing to spending/data.gov.ua — mine once for dataset leads, no independent signal stream.
Stable national catalogue entry documenting official bulk/API distribution endpoints for Prozorro procurement data.
AMCU complaint decisions name both parties and quote disputed specs — highest-signal evidence of vendor spec-locking.
Audit-service monitoring conclusions expose specifications written around a specific vendor's product.
E-catalogue is a distinct dataset from the tender feed, with qualified supplier lists and unit prices for banking peripherals.
Operator knowledge base — read once to interpret procedure types and award terminology before building the pipeline.
Single publication-quality assessment record; useful methodological evidence on OCDS coverage, not a recurring feed.
One tender record proving card-platform incumbency (Tietoevry Card Suite) and validating CPV 72261000-2 as a filter.
Registry aggregator with supplier alerting, but useful depth sits behind subscription/API terms a human must clear.
Largest UA job board; vacancy texts name core-banking, card and ATM brands — durable indirect vendor-stack signal.
Per-employer view on work.ua; covered by monitoring the board with employer-scoped queries.
Individual CVs are personal data of identifiable private persons — not appropriate to collect or monitor.
Largest UA IT job marketplace; bank/fintech postings expose integration and processing stacks per employer.
DOU company profiles combine vacancies, headcount and self-declared stacks for the main UA banks.
UPC vacancy page is a sub-page of jobs.dou.ua; very high value but captured by an employer-scoped crawl of the parent.
Annual bank IT-headcount ranking article — a dated artefact that prioritises the actor list; refresh yearly.
Tag feed producing continuous community/editorial signal on bank stacks and migrations; credibility moderate.
First-party ATS of the largest UA bank; carries terminal/self-service roles invisible on aggregators.
Top-5 bank's own ATS is valuable, but URL verification failed — re-check reachability in the browser pass before approving.
Regulator vacancy feed signals SEP/ISO 20022 and oversight tooling priorities that drive market-wide vendor demand.
Second major board with non-overlapping second-tier bank employers naming ABS B2 and Is-Card incumbents.
